plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Pan Dacom transmission device. It reports uptime, temperature, fan, and interface traffic, for CWDM optical transmission chassis (enterprise PEN 3652).
name: Transmission

metrics.name: temperature_celsius
metrics.description: NMS board temperature in degrees Celsius from nmATemperature under PEN 3652. High values may indicate cooling problems, high ambient temperature or overloaded hardware.

metrics.name: psu1_status
metrics.description: Operational state of chassis power supply 1 from nmPSU1Status. Native codes are notInstalled (0), fail (1), temperatureWarning (2), and pass (3). fail or temperatureWarning should be investigated; notInstalled means the slot is unused.

metrics.name: psu2_status
metrics.description: Operational state of chassis power supply 2 from nmPSU2Status. Native codes are notInstalled (0), fail (1), temperatureWarning (2), and pass (3). fail or temperatureWarning should be investigated; notInstalled means the slot is unused.

metrics.name: fan_status
metrics.description: Optional chassis fan state from nmFanState. Native codes are notAvailable (0), pass (3), fail (4), and notInstalled (5). fail indicates a cooling-module fault; notAvailable or notInstalled means the object is unused on this chassis.

metrics.name: psu3_status
metrics.description: Optional chassis power supply 3 state from nmPSU3Status. Native codes are notInstalled (0), fail (1), temperatureWarning (2), pass (3), and notAvailable (255). fail or temperatureWarning should be investigated; notInstalled and notAvailable mean the slot is unused or unsupported.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
